title: Virtual Latinos Teams Up with Clio to Support Law Firm Operations and Boost Efficiency
text:
Virtual Latinos is now integrated with Clio - the world’s leading cloud-based legal technology platform.
Through this partnership, Clio users gain access to pre-vetted Virtual Assistants from Latin America, helping law firms streamline administrative tasks such as client intake, case management, and billing. By leveraging Virtual Assistants, firms can reduce time spent on routine tasks from half a day to just 20 minutes, accelerating client onboarding by up to four days. Additionally, law firms using Clio’s online payment system collect payments up to five times faster than traditional methods, improving cash flow and revenue.
Virtual Latinos connects top-tier talent from Latin America with businesses in the United States, offering highly skilled human resource solutions. Partnering with Clio aims to address legal professionals' efficiency and staffing challenges, offering Clio users access to highly experienced, qualified, and pre-vetted Virtual Assistants. This benefits firms by reducing half-a-day time to only twenty minutes spent on tasks such as client intake and streamlining processes to onboard clients up to four days faster.
“We are excited to announce this strategic partnership. The cutting-edge technology of Clio combined with the specialized expertise of Virtual Assistants will enable a significant work efficiency for legal professionals,” — said Jaime Nacach, founder and CEO of Virtual Latinos. — “By leveraging Virtual Assistants to handle several tasks, law firms can have a better management of their workload with Clio’s technology, saving valuable hours each week that can be redirected toward client-focused work.”
By combining Clio’s automation with Virtual Latinos’ expert support, this partnership offers a seamless, high-performance workflow solution that enables legal professionals to take on more cases while enhancing the overall client experience.
For additional information, visit Innovate Your Law Firm with Case Management Software .
About Virtual Latinos
Virtual Latinos specializes in connecting businesses with top virtual assistants from Latin America. Each assistant is pre-vetted, highly skilled, and ready to support businesses in various needs. Virtual Latinos operate in U.S. time zones and ensure real-time client support and productivity. Their community is known for its personalized service, hand-picking the top 1% of talent, and fostering long-term relationships between clients and virtual assistants.

About Clio
Since its inception in 2008, Clio has revolutionized the landscape of legal technology, emerging as the undisputed leader of innovation and integration. By offering advanced yet intuitive legal software, Clio has redefined efficiency and client service, setting the standard for legal professionals across the globe. With an unwavering commitment to groundbreaking innovation and customer success, Clio stands as the preeminent authority in legaltech, continuously pushing the boundaries of the sector’s evolution.
